name: Boatwomen tending a fire, and other  studies of standing or walking figures
summary: The three figures on the left are (as the inscription confirms) burning 'joss papers’ - coloured or decorated paper made from bamboo - at the tomb of their ancestors; this was (and is) a traditional act of worship or respect for one’s forebears,performed especially at festivals.

collection.museum: 维多利亚与艾尔伯特博物馆
